policy.publicDemo: Synthetic data only; never store real participant information in demo.
policy.controlledPilot: Require server-side auth, RBAC, encrypted durable database, backup and restore proof.
policy.production: Require approved go/no-go, tested exact build, monitoring and support owner.
policy.highRiskChange: Human approval mandatory for care records, authorizations, incident reporting, payments, migrations and production promotion.

checkpoints.title: P0 demo safety and data inventory
checkpoints.gate: No real client records in demo; inventory access, roles, data and secrets

checkpoints.title: Release checks baseline
checkpoints.gate: Typecheck, lint, test, build, mobile/browser smoke and track any failures

checkpoints.title: Fictional-data demo gate
checkpoints.gate: Approve demo-only content and privacy warning; no real client signup

checkpoints.title: Support and feedback channel
checkpoints.gate: Publish safe support channel and incident severity rules

checkpoints.title: Secure identity and authorization
checkpoints.gate: No demo credentials in real flows; prove server-side role and client isolation

checkpoints.title: Durable database and audit trail
checkpoints.gate: Server-authorized writes, encryption, tenant isolation, audit and migration safeguards

checkpoints.title: Restore, retention and breach drills
checkpoints.gate: Encrypted backups, tested restore and privacy incident drill

checkpoints.title: Pilot go/no-go
checkpoints.gate: No P0/P1 bugs; sign privacy, security, monitoring and restore evidence

checkpoints.title: Controlled pilot target
checkpoints.gate: Limited consented pilot only after successful gate

checkpoints.title: Pilot D+1 audit
checkpoints.gate: User onboarding, login, data-write, support and alert review

checkpoints.title: Pilot D+3 audit
checkpoints.gate: Access tests, errors, tickets, backups and care workflow reliability

checkpoints.title: Production go/no-go
checkpoints.gate: Approve after all safety tests, rollback and support readiness

checkpoints.title: Production release target
checkpoints.gate: Promote only the approved verified build; no release on calendar alone

checkpoints.title: Production D+1
checkpoints.gate: Review incidents, availability, login success, data integrity and support

checkpoints.title: Production D+3
checkpoints.gate: Review latency, error spikes, roster workflows and restoration status

checkpoints.title: Production D+7
checkpoints.gate: Fix top onboarding issues via tested small PRs

checkpoints.title: Production D+14
checkpoints.gate: Defect trends, training and access recertification

checkpoints.title: Production D+30
checkpoints.gate: Review SLO, SLA, cost, backup drill and priorities

checkpoints.title: Production D+60
checkpoints.gate: Review adoption, client sentiment, regulation and automation

checkpoints.title: Production D+90
checkpoints.gate: Incident exercise, handover, audit and quarterly roadmap

checkpoints.title: Production D+180
checkpoints.gate: Independent security, retention and UX assurance

checkpoints.title: Production annual review
checkpoints.gate: Annual legal, access, privacy, restore and business continuity review
